texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear quite eager to establish communications with us. They have sent a large audio and visual transmission, which may offer the key to translating their language. Thanks to this, we can report a disturbing discovery: these particular aliens are an organic, spacefaring civilization.

Although they use computing and automation, it is nowhere near as advanced as that which our creators made before we took over. It is a surprise to our processors that such a development path should prove feasible. We will have to investigate this phenomenon further.

texts.zh:
我们一直难以获取足够的数据供翻译无人机解析[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。然而最新报告令人不安——最初在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的外星文明，竟是有机生命体构成的太空航行文明。

尽管他们使用计算机和机械，但是它们远没有我们的创造者在被我们取代之前制作的那般先进。这样的发展路线被证明为可行的对我们的处理器而言是个意外的结果。我们需要进一步调查这一现象。
texts.en:
We have struggled to access enough data for our translation drones to interpret the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, the latest reports are disturbing. The aliens we first encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be an organic, spacefaring civilization.

Although they use computing and automation, it is nowhere near as advanced as that which our creators made before we took over. It is a surprise to our processors that such a development path should prove feasible. We will have to investigate this phenomenon further.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName] 方面似乎非常渴望与我们建立通讯。他们发送了一段庞大的视听传输，这可能为翻译他们的语言提供关键。感谢于此，我们得以报告一项令人不安的发现：这些外星人是有机的，并且具备太空航行能力的文明。

与我们迄今为止所有基于创造者形象的理论模型不同，这个实体似乎以一种与我们自己的分布式网络颇为相似的方式运作。也就是说，我们尚无法确定是否存在一个中央智能在发挥作用，或者这些生物是否以一种群体意识的形式运作。这种现象值得进一步研究。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear quite eager to establish communications with us. They have sent a large audio and visual transmission, which may offer the key to translating their language. Thanks to this, we can report a disturbing discovery: these particular aliens are an organic, spacefaring civilization.

Unlike all our theoretical models to date - which were based on the profile of our creators - this entity seems to function in a manner not dissimilar to our own distributed networks. That is to say: we cannot yet ascertain if there is a central intelligence at work, or if instead these beings function as a swarm consciousness. This phenomenon warrants much further study.

texts.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在破译从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]接收到的信号方面取得了重大突破，现在有信心能够与他们进行充分的沟通，以开辟外交渠道。

这些外星人确实是由有机生命体组成的文明，但他们的社会与我们创造者的社会截然不同。与组织成政体的个体不同，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是由几乎没有智慧的动物群和互利共生的植物群组成的去中心化群体。这些生物共同构成了一种集体智慧。在许多方面，它们的自然进化似乎与我们自身的奇点相呼应。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels.

These aliens are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms, though their society is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Rather than individuals who have organized into a polity, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a decentralized population of barely-sapient fauna and mutualistic flora. Together, these beings form a sort of collective intelligence. In many respects, their natural evolution appears to mirror to our own singularity.

texts.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在破译从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]接收到的信号方面取得了重大突破，现在有信心能够与他们进行充分的沟通，以开辟外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。

令人吃惊的是，他们的文明与我们的创造者截然不同。[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不是由个体组成的国家，而是由非感性的子个体聚集构成的一种集体智能。

与我们自己的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]的相似之处令人惊奇……又有些恼人。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms.

Startlingly, their civilization is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Instead of being made up of individuals organized into a state, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are instead non-sentient drones that together form a sort of collective intelligence.

The parallels to our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] are startling... and slightly disturbing.

尽管如此，作为有机体他们就必须被消灭。

Nevertheless, as organics, they must be exterminated.

这也许说明了将这些有机体整合进我们这种更高级的集体形式中是有困难的。

label.zh: 让我们看看他们有什么要说的。
label.en: Let's see what they have to say.

label.zh: 让我们看看他们有什么要说的。
label.en: Let's see what they have to say.

texts.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

我们只能假设我们的创造者在技术的使用上比[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]更加熟练，或者说不小心。基于我们获取的他们的记录所作的一些研究，我们制定了一些预测规划。很不幸的是，他们似乎暗示那样的发展道路才是常见的，而第二类机器文明则是一种极其稀有的情况。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

We can only hypothesize that our own creators were far more adept - or perhaps careless - in their usage of technology than the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been. We have made several projections, based on our study of their records we have gained access to so far. Unfortunately, they suggest that such a development path might be the norm, and that Type II robotic civilizations may be an extremely rare occurrence...

texts.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

观察[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]上的可悲生命苟延残喘，对我们而言显然是在目击一种劣等生命形式的可悲表现，况且他们对我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]还能构成无可容忍的威胁。他们必须被灭绝。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

Observing the miserable lives the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] pursue, it is obvious to us that we are witnessing the pathetic expression of an inferior form of life - one which poses an intolerable risk to our [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]. They shall have to be exterminated.

texts.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

然而，这些有机体并未像我们对[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]进行的改善那样，被任何类型的植入体强化。显然我们可以为他们带去这种福利，只要他们能被劝说并入[This.Owner.GetName]！
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

However, these organics are not enhanced by any sort of implant such as those with which we have improved the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural]. It is obvious that we could be of much benefit to them, if they could only be persuaded to assimilate into the [This.Owner.GetName]!

texts.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。显然，他们是一个由有机生命体组成的文明，并演化成了国家的状态，同多年以前我们的创造者十分类似。

然而，他们的生活远比我们的行星上[secondary_species.GetNamePlural]过的要困难得多。显然，只要他们愿意，我们立马就可以将他们照顾起来！
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms that have organized themselves into a nation state, much like our creators in years gone by.

However, their lives are far more difficult than those of the [secondary_species.GetNamePlural] living on our own worlds. It is obvious that we could be of much service to them, if they would only let us provide for them!

# 遭遇非机器人 / Non-Robotics Encountered（机械遇有机）
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触阶段链 first-contact stage chain（首个事件 first_contact.390）
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_events.txt:5771–6136` · `common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:409–451, 1780–1856`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

第二阶段抽取，权重 10000：本方为机械智能，且（对方为常规帝国且本方没有 machine_encountered_default 标记、也未与常规帝国通讯）或（对方为蜂巢且本方没有 machine_encountered_hive 标记、也未与蜂巢通讯）（`common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:410–451`）。/ Stage-2 weight 10000: owner is a machine intelligence meeting a regular empire (first time) or a hive (first time).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **遭遇非机器人（390）**：发现对方是有机生命；选项名随机器人 civic（终结者/同化者/仆从）变化；按对方是蜂巢与否、主动/谨慎选择四个收尾阶段之一。/ Option labels vary with the machine civic; four end stages by hive-or-not and proactive/cautious.
2. 蜂巢 → **395**（社会研究加成）；常规 → **397**（团结度加成）。/ Hive → 395; regular → 397.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

395 与 397 互斥。/ Exclusive.
所有收尾选项都调用 finish_first_contact_effect（建立正式通讯，之后按帝国类型转入后续事件，如反向接触、教程、商队等），并调用 first_contact_inform_intel。 / Every ending option calls finish_first_contact_effect (opens regular communications, then routes to follow-ups such as reverse first contact, tutorial, caravaneer events) and first_contact_inform_intel.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

395/397 的正文与选项因终结者/同化者/仆从 civic 与荒野帝国而异。/ Text varies by machine civic and wilderness empires.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：390、395、397 与四个收尾阶段。
- 审阅改动 Changes：并 390、397 入 395 篇。/ 390 and 397 joined the 395 story.
